action:
After a standard system update you need to restart nfdump to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that nfdump incorrectly handled certain input files,
leading to a buffer overflow. If a user or automated system were tricked
into processing a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause nfdump to crash or execute arbitrary code.
(CVE-2019-1010057)

It was discovered that nfdump incorrectly handled certain IPFIX template
withdrawal messages, leading to an integer overflow. A remote attacker
could possibly use this issue to cause nfdump to crash, resulting in a
denial of service. (CVE-2019-14459)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in nfdump.
title: nfdump vulnerabilities
